commits.title: The surface budget: fourteen counts and the hot tables' indexes and triggers, held by a scan

changes.how: Test support (the folder src/test is not counted by the code ratchet). Export async function surfaceCounts(root: string): Promise<SurfaceCounts>. It returns an object with exactly these keys, each counted as said. dispatcherJobs: read src/server/dispatcher-jobs.ts (made by step 1.10) as text; take the lines after the line that starts 'export const DISPATCHER_JOBS = {' up to the first later line that starts with '}' (the closing `} satisfies …;`); count the lines that match /^  (\w+|"[^"]+"): (\(|async \()/ (69 once step 0.31 has removed nine prunes, 78 on 12 November: one per job key, two spaces in; comments and nested lines, four or more spaces in, are skipped; the same count step 1.10's check makes); add the number of matches of /tracked\("dispatcher\.[^"]+"/g in the whole text of src/app/api/cron/cart-reminders/route.ts (5 today; these calls stay in the route after step 1.10). minuteRoutes: the files src/app/api/cron/*/route.ts whose text matches /trackedRoute\("[^"]+",\s*60,/ (9 today). pages: files named page.tsx under src/app (560 today). routeHandlers: files named route.ts or route.tsx under src/app (268 today). storeLinks: STORE_SECTIONS.flatMap((s) => s.groups.flatMap((g) => g.items)).length from '@/lib/store-nav' (110 today). storeLinksBySection: an object from each section's key to its number of items. basicLinks: over STORE_SECTIONS, the items for which advancedIn(section, item) is false, summed (42 today; src/lib/store-nav.test.ts line 245 counts it the same way). platformLinks: the summed lengths of WEBSITE_ITEMS, PLAN_ITEMS, SUPPORT_ITEMS and SETTINGS_ITEMS from '@/lib/platform-nav' (the only four item arrays the file exports, lines 18, 48, 59 and 68; the review counted 52; the sum stands as counted, and a different figure is reported, not chased). storeTools: OWNER_TOOLS.length from '@/lib/owner-tools' (254 today). shopOnlyTools: OWNER_TOOLS.filter((t) => toolOffered({ features: ["shop"] }, t.name)).length with toolOffered from '@/lib/owner-tool-features' (234 today; pass whatever shape its FeatureSource type needs for a store with only the shop on, as src/lib/store-nav.test.ts builds its ALL constant). managerTools: MANAGER_TOOLS.length from '@/lib/manager-tools' (26 today). featureIds: FEATURE_IDS.length from '@/lib/store-features' (14 today). Then, from one database made by createTestDatabase() of '@/db/testing' (close it at the end): tables: select count(*) from information_schema.tables where table_schema = 'commerce' and table_type = 'BASE TABLE' (486 today, 5 more than schema.ts declares: tables a custom migration makes are counted too). platformTables: the same with table_name like 'platform\_%' (19 today). hot: for each name of HOT_TABLES (import it from '@/db/migration-safety.scan.test' only if that does not run its tests on import; otherwise copy the eight names: orders, order_lines, visits, products, product_variants, customers, carts, cart_lines, and add a test that the copy equals HOT_TABLES), { indexes: select count(*) from pg_indexes where schemaname = 'commerce' and tablename = $1, triggers: select count(*) from pg_trigger t join pg_class c on c.oid = t.tgrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace where n.nspname = 'commerce' and c.relname = $1 and not t.tgisinternal }. Also export the pure function surfaceProblems(now, baseline): string[] : for every numeric key, every section of storeLinksBySection and every hot table's two numbers, a string when now is above the baseline ('<key>: <now>, budget <n>. A new job, page, table, link, tool, index or trigger adds cost to every store: write its decision with an Idle cost: line, then run node scripts/surface-budget.mjs --raise D<number>.') and export surfaceFallen(now, baseline): string[] for every number below its baseline ('<key> fell to <now>: run node scripts/surface-budget.mjs'). newStoreRows is not counted here: src/db/commerce.test.ts holds it (commit 2). Also export idleCostOf(decisionText: string): string | null : the text after the first 'Idle cost:' up to the next '|' or line end, trimmed, or null when there is none or it is empty.

A vitest file modelled on src/server/ratchet.scan.test.ts and, for writing its baseline, on src/lib/admin-strings.scan.test.ts (which writes when UPDATE_ADMIN_STRINGS=1). In a beforeAll with a 60 s timeout call surfaceCounts(process.cwd()). When process.env.SURFACE_BUDGET is 'lower', 'first' or starts with 'raise:', one test 'writes the baseline' does the writing and the other cases are skipped: 'first' writes every count and keeps or creates the keys newStoreRows (leave the old value or 8), twins and raises; 'lower' refuses (throws, listing surfaceProblems) when anything rose, else writes the counts; 'raise:D123' reads the decision's text (the row of docs/decisions.md that starts '| D123 |', or the file docs/decisions/D123.md when that folder exists), throws 'D123 has no Idle cost: line. Write what the feature costs a store that does not use it: per request, per scheduled run and per cold start (none where none).' when idleCostOf() is null, else writes the counts and appends to raises one entry per count that rose: { count, from, to, decision }. Otherwise the cases are: (1) 'no count rose without a raise': expect(surfaceProblems(now, baseline)).toEqual([]). (2) 'the baseline is as low as the code': expect(surfaceFallen(now, baseline)).toEqual([]). (3) 'holds fourteen counts': the baseline has a number for each of dispatcherJobs, minuteRoutes, pages, routeHandlers, tables, platformTables, storeLinks, basicLinks, platformLinks, storeTools, shopOnlyTools, managerTools, featureIds and newStoreRows, and hot has all eight tables. (4) 'every raise names a decision with an idle cost': for each entry of baseline.raises the decision's text gives a non-null idleCostOf(). (5) 'every twin kept on purpose has its reason': each entry of baseline.twins has a name, a non-empty reason and a decision. (6) the trials, as unit cases on the pure functions with structuredClone(now): one more dispatcher job fails surfaceProblems; a page fewer than the baseline shows in surfaceFallen; one more table fails; one more trigger on orders fails; idleCostOf('| D9 | **X.** Text.') is null and idleCostOf('| D9 | **X.** Text. Idle cost: none per request; one statement per tick.') is the text. (7) two cases that prove the counters read the real thing, on a scratch database from createTestDatabase(): after 'create table commerce.surface_trial (id int)' the table count is the baseline's plus 1 (this is the table schema.ts does not declare); after 'create trigger surface_trial before update on commerce.orders for each row execute function commerce.<any existing trigger function>()' (take a function name from select tgfoid::regproc from pg_trigger ... limit 1 on orders) the orders trigger count is plus 1. Export the count queries from src/test/surface-count.ts as tableCount(db) and hotCounts(db) so these cases can call them on the scratch database.

A thin wrapper, because the counts import TypeScript modules and so run inside vitest. Usage in a header comment: 'node scripts/surface-budget.mjs' lowers; 'node scripts/surface-budget.mjs --raise D123' raises after checking the decision; '--first' writes the first baseline. It sets SURFACE_BUDGET to 'lower', 'raise:D123' or 'first' and runs spawnSync('pnpm', ['exec', 'vitest', 'run', 'src/lib/surface-budget.scan.test.ts'], { stdio: 'inherit', env }) and exits with its status. '--raise' without an id matching /^D\d+$/ prints the usage and exits 1.

Written by node scripts/surface-budget.mjs --first, never typed. Then add by hand only the list twins: one entry { name, reason, decision } for each pair of engines the owner keeps twice on purpose. Take them from the verdict files of step 0.42 (ls docs/audits/bloat-review-2026-11/findings/features/) and from the plan's tolerated line: the platform's four event engines beside the stores' (workflows, own endpoints, integration deliveries and their runs, 19 platform_* tables), reason 'the platform's rows are apart from the stores' by the owner's rule of 6 November 2026; they run on shared code after step 3.10'. A pair that 0.42 or the plan marks 'fold' (order rules beside Workflows, the second kaizenaflow.com, an own look in commerce.store_themes) is not listed: it is a step, not a twin. Leave raises as an empty list. After writing, compare with the review's figures and report every difference: dispatcherJobs 83 (lower if step 0.31 is done), minuteRoutes 9, pages 560, routeHandlers 268, tables 486, platformTables 19, storeLinks 110, basicLinks 42, platformLinks 52, storeTools 254, shopOnlyTools 234, managerTools 26, featureIds 14; hot orders 32 indexes and 27 triggers after step 0.26, products 13 and 14, carts 11 and 1, order_lines 8 and 5, customers 8 and 6, product_variants 6 and 7, cart_lines 5 and 0, visits 2 and 0.

changes.how: Add one describe at the end of the file, 'what the database writes for a new store (surface budget)'. Case: insert a store exactly as the file's createStore() does but without markets: const { id } = await one<{ id: string }>("insert into commerce.stores (slug, name) values ($1, $1) returning id", ['surface-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)]). Then list every table of the commerce schema that has a column store_id (select table_name from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'commerce' and column_name = 'store_id' and table_name in (select table_name from information_schema.tables where table_schema = 'commerce' and table_type = 'BASE TABLE')), and for each run select count(*)::int as n from commerce.<table> where store_id = $1 (quote the table name with double quotes). Build an object of table to n for the tables with n above 0 and the sum. Expect the sum to equal the newStoreRows of src/lib/surface-budget.baseline.json (import the JSON; 8 in the review: 5 number series, 1 payment provider, 1 blog, 1 theme install), with the message: 'A new store now gets ' + sum + ' rows (' + JSON.stringify(byTable) + '). A row every store gets for a feature that is off is idle cost: write the decision with an Idle cost: line and run node scripts/surface-budget.mjs --raise D<number>, or make the row when the feature is switched on.' The plain insert autocommits, so the deferred constraint trigger platform_store_created has run by the time of the count. A second case, the trial: on the same database run exactly `create function commerce.surface_trial() returns trigger language plpgsql as $$ begin insert into commerce.blogs (store_id, handle) values (new.id, 'surface-trial'); return null; end $$` and `create trigger surface_trial after insert on commerce.stores for each row execute function commerce.surface_trial()` (a second blog: commerce.blogs needs only store_id and handle, its unique keys are (store_id, handle) and one main blog per store, and the first blog that stores_first_blog() makes is handle 'blog', main true, so the two never collide). Insert another store and expect the sum to be the baseline's plus 1; drop the trigger and function in a finally block. If newStoreRows in the baseline was left at 8 by --first and the first case measures another number, set the baseline to the measured number by hand once and report it.

In the 'lower' and 'raise' writers keep newStoreRows as it is in the file (the scan does not count it). Add to case (3) that newStoreRows is a number. Add the comment: the new-store count is measured and compared in src/db/commerce.test.ts.

commits.title: Switches are for what an owner sees, and a rise in the surface states its idle cost

changes.how: Add one paragraph under a new heading '## Switches are not for cost' near the top, after the introduction: a feature switch decides what an owner sees and can use; it is never added to save cost. 53 of 110 store links and 133 of 254 AI tools stand behind no switch on purpose. Where a feature costs a store that does not use it (a read on every basket, a statement on every scheduled run, a tool definition in every AI round), the fix is at the read: do no work when the feature has no rows. A new feature states that cost in its decision, in a line that starts 'Idle cost:' (per request, per scheduled run, per cold start; 'none' where none), and src/lib/surface-budget.scan.test.ts refuses a new job, table, trigger, link or tool until the line is there. Lines of at most 130 characters.

The file is the budgets rule step 1.1 wrote under docs/rules (find it: rg -l 'baseline.json' docs/rules). Row at most 300 characters. Add no sentence to CLAUDE.md.
